hypothesis: The already frozen canonical annual cash-advantage head may contain information not evaluated separately in the allocation chain. Test its predictive information and one-period fee hurdle before designing another allocation optimizer. This is not a new feature source and no positive old-data finding is transferred.

source.limitations: Published affine basis differs slightly from serverQFQ; Jan2012 secondary quote uncertainty remains. Rebuilt history is not fresh out-of-sample evidence.

parent_input_source.input_contract: Hash-verified frozen qualified primary/prices/OOF forecasts and forecast models. Reconstruct nativeDatasetH/scalers; development folds must exactly match parent. No data refresh or forecast retuning.

source_readback_contract.scope: Reconstruct native D calendar/instruments/OHLCV, exact primary frame and DatasetH, and hash-bound parent forecast artifacts. Legacy allocation folds checked only as input-integrity evidence; no allocator loaded or run.

forecast.training: Unchanged joint feature/one-day/five-day label availability strictly before Jan1 America/New_York, minimum252, eligible source since2011-01-03. Check exact original eligible dates and saved audit; no fits.
forecast.prediction_audit: Recompute saved pipeline.predict on the same canonical features and require allclose atol1e-14 rtol1e-12 against frozen predictions; record max absolute errors. Do not replace the cached predictions.
forecast.baseline: Saved ridge.intercept_[0]; independently check against mean cash label on exact original eligible training rows, atol1e-14 rtol1e-12. Centered StandardScaler makes this a prior-only mean forecast.
forecast.maturity: Evaluate only finite H1 outcomes observable by source as_of; late immature H1 rows retained with explicit unavailable flags, never scored. H5 not required for evaluating already-fitted cash predictions.

windows.annual: All11 years separately, 2026 through last mature source outcome

statistics.baseline_constant_IC: Undefined within each year, not zero; report as null with reason. Pooled baseline IC may reflect between-year drift and must be labeled.
statistics.demeaning: Demean predictions and target separately within each signal year of the evaluated window; analysis only, no inference-time transformation.
statistics.calibration: Descriptive OLS target ~ intercept + frozen_prediction, HAC covariance maxlags20 with finite-sample correction, normal95percent intervals. Repeat baseline if fullrank, otherwise report rank deficiency. This is diagnostic regression, never a refitted forecasting model, new calibrated prediction, or selection recipe.
statistics.bins: None; no searched bins, thresholds, horizons, model variants or multiple-comparison-adjusted confirmatory claim.

event_diagnostic.event: Isolated event begins fully invested in SOXX immediately before open[t+1]; sells fully to CASH then repurchases SOXX at open[t+2]. Compare with continuously held SOXX over that interval. Cashreturn0, proportional exact funding, no lending/borrow.
event_diagnostic.baseline_event: Use the identical threshold against saved prior mean; paired point comparison only, not separately optimized.
event_diagnostic.limitations: Events overlap in decision time; do not compound, annualize or report as realizable portfolio return. A one-day detour fee test does not establish whether a multi-day cash policy can work. No spreads/latency/slippage beyond declared10/25bp all-in proportional assumption.

uncertainty.method: Stationary bootstrap of the full chronological observation rows, preserving target/prediction/baseline/event-mask pairs. Circular within each evaluated pooled window, fixed mean block length20 and60,2000 draws, seed20261003. Reinitialize RNG to same seed for each window/block; use same row indices for all statistics within that pair.
uncertainty.scope: Only the two pooled windows; yearly and user window point metrics only.
uncertainty.demeaned_bootstrap: Center using original full-window within-year means before row resampling. This quantifies sampling variability of that fixed diagnostic series, not a refitted/year-stratified estimator.
uncertainty.intervals: Percentiles2.5,50,97.5; retain raw draws in Recorder. Report total and undefined draw counts. If any conditional-event draw has zero events, official percentile fields null and record reason; optional finite-draw percentiles distinctly labeled conditional_on_nonempty. Never discard silently or replace undefined with zero.
uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive dependent-data intervals on reused historical windows, not a new untouched test or multiple-comparison corrected confirmation.
